name: GetMediaTools
tagline: A collection of tools designed for archivists, video editors, and content creators
description: A collection of tools designed for archivists, video editors, and content creators. Users can paste a URL from TikTok, Twitter/X, or Facebook, and our backend scripts will locate and securely download the unwatermarked MP4 or MP3 file. It is 100% free, requires no sign-ups.
